Market today:
The market mood is cautiously optimistic for tech, driven by a slide in the 10-year Treasury yield. Lower yields typically boost growth stocks, which is good news for your concentrated tech and chip portfolio.

Your holdings:
SOXL and SPAL are flashing red, both down over 30% and flagged "SELL." As leveraged ETFs, their decay and your margin amplify these significant drawdowns. Address these first.

Watch:
Keep an eye on the 10-year yield for continued support for tech. Also, watch for any further news on new tech companies potentially hitting the retail market.

Bottom line:
Prioritize managing your leveraged losers and protect your capital, especially with margin.
plays: Trim SOXL and SPAL: These leveraged ETFs are decaying and deeply in the red (-30.93%, -32.21%). Consider reducing exposure to mitigate further losses, especially on margin.
Consider adding to SNOW: With the 10-year yield sliding and SNOW showing an "ACCUMULATE" scanner setup (entry 339.36-338.98, stop 337.03) in a daily discount, it could be a good entry.
